sources: June 2026 BTC crash: $3B liquidated / ~$450M in single cascade events
_notes.liqUSD_rationale: Normal BTC perpetual market sees $10M-$50M/hr total liquidations. $1M/60s = elevated, $5M/60s = stress, $15M/60s = cascade event.
_notes.liqCount_rationale: Typical quiet market: 5-20 liq events/60s across all assets. >50 = elevated, >100 = cascade warning.
_notes.fundingZ_rationale: Standard stat threshold: |Z|>2.0 is notable, |Z|>2.5 is extreme (TradingView default). Funding >0.10%/8h on Kraken = overleveraged.
_notes.priceChange_rationale: BTC 3% move in 5min is significant (June 2026 cascade was 3.6% in hours). ETH/SOL are more volatile so thresholds are higher.
_notes.oiChange_rationale: OI swinging >5% in 30min signals aggressive position opening/closing. >8% warrants alert.
_notes.orderFlowImbalance_rationale: OFI is 0-100 (50=balanced). Below 30 or above 70 = notable imbalance. Below 20 / above 80 = aggressive directional flow.
_notes.longShortRatio_rationale: Normal range: 0.9-1.5. Below 0.7 = extreme short bias (potential short squeeze). Above 2.5 = extreme long crowding (liquidation cascade risk).
_notes.supportLoad_rationale: Derived from real liq count. >20 real events/60s across all assets = support team stress.

liqCount60s.rationale: Sum across all 3 assets. Normal market: 5-20/60s. 80+ = elevated cascade risk.

liqUSD60s.rationale: $2M/60s = significant stress. $5M+ = wave event. Based on Coinglass data: typical cascade starts at ~$1-3M/min spike.

supportLoad.rationale: Estimated support tickets derived from liq count. >25 = staff load alert.

liqWaveUSD.rationale: $5M/60s + 25+ events = liquidation wave. Confirmed by Arxiv cascade research.

priceChangePct.rationale: BTC moving >2.5% in 5min is a major move. June 2026 cascade was 3.6% over hours — 2.5% in 5min is faster and more alarming.

fundingRateZScore.rationale: Z>2.0 = statistically extreme. TradingView default is 2.5 but 2.0 gives earlier warning for exchange ops.

oiChangePct.rationale: OI swinging 5%+ in a 30min window = aggressive position change. Cascade research shows 25-70% OI clearance during major events — 5% is early warning.

longShortRatio.rationale: Ratio below 0.75 = shorts heavily dominating, potential short squeeze setup.

orderFlowImbalance.rationale: Deviation from 50 (balanced). Fires when buyPct < 20 or > 80 (30pts from center). Normal markets oscillate 45-55. 10min cooldown prevents spam.

priceChangePct.rationale: ETH is more volatile than BTC. 3% in 5min = significant. June 2026 saw ETH drop 3.4% in a cascade session.

oiChangePct.rationale: ETH OI is more volatile. 6% swing = meaningful structural change.

orderFlowImbalance.rationale: Same deviation threshold as BTC. 10min cooldown.

priceChangePct.rationale: SOL is higher beta. 4% in 5min = notable. XRP dropped 8.2% in the June 2026 cascade — SOL typically moves 1.5-2x BTC.

fundingRateZScore.rationale: Slightly higher threshold for SOL given naturally higher funding volatility.

oiChangePct.rationale: SOL OI swings more aggressively. 7% threshold avoids noise.

longShortRatio.rationale: Slightly lower threshold — SOL longs tend to be more aggressive.

orderFlowImbalance.rationale: Same deviation threshold across all assets.
